title: cliEval suite manifest
description: Schema for cliEval suite manifests (suites/*.yaml). Roadmap DM-011 / Deliverable D-0002. Validation is performed by superclaude.cli.eval.loader.validate_manifest (T01.04) prior to any filesystem write.

name.description: Suite name; matches the CLI --suite argument.

version.description: Schema/version tag for forward evolution (M1 Risk-3).

defaults.description: Suite-wide default knobs applied to every eval unless overridden.

required_binaries.description: HARD capability gates: missing binary aborts the run.

optional_capabilities.description: SOFT capability gates: missing capability skips gated evals.

evals.description: Eval entries (DM-002). Length is N pre-expansion; parameterize expansion happens in COMP-002.

evalIdString.description: Eval identifier. Must match FR-SCH2 regex to prevent path traversal in HomeIsolation (T01.05 re-validates this post-expansion).

parameterizeRow.description: One row of template-variable substitutions. Keys are placeholder names referenced as {{key}} elsewhere in the eval entry; values are the concrete substitutions.

evalEntry.description: Parsed manifest entry (DM-002): id, title, category, requires, timeout_sec, isolation, inputs, expects, parameterize.

parameterize.description: Array of substitution rows. Each row produces one expanded eval (E2 → E2.1, E2.2, ...). Template tokens MUST resolve to schema-valid ids per FR-SCH2.

no_pty.description: PTY-exclusion tag (DOC-OQ3 / R-077 / D-0077). When set to "skip", `superclaude eval run --no-pty` short-circuits the eval and emits an EvalOutcome with status SKIPPED, skip_reason="--no-pty", and skip_flag_triggered="--no-pty" before any HOME setup. The tag is advisory metadata for the runner; it does NOT affect runs that are not invoked with --no-pty.
